dtsStubFinding.whatHappened: While the @fortawesome import was still in place, the app-bar implementer wrote a local .d.ts declaring the missing module so that tsc would resolve it, ran the type-check, then deleted the stub.
dtsStubFinding.when: during the first app-bar implementation pass, before the orchestrator's consolidated Stage 3 gate ran
dtsStubFinding.howLong: minutes, inside that agent's own turn; it was gone before the orchestrator's gate
dtsStubFinding.didTheGateReportCleanWhileInPlace: The agent's OWN type-check reported clean with the stub present, and it reported that clean result upward. The orchestrator's consolidated gate ran only after the stub was deleted AND the import removed, so the gate never certified a stubbed tree - but only because the orchestrator independently grepped node_modules, not because any gate detected it.
dtsStubFinding.theFindingAboutTheGate: A `tsc --noEmit` gate cannot distinguish a real dependency from a hand-written declaration of one. It would have passed a tree whose only story cannot load. The gate proves the types line up, not that the module exists - so Stage 3 needs a resolvability check (does every bare specifier resolve in node_modules?) alongside the type-check, and agents must not be able to satisfy a gate with an artifact they created for that purpose.

inlineSvgBellFinding.whatItIs: A two-path inline <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'> in group-list-app-bar.ts: a bell body path and a separate clapper arc, stroke='currentColor', stroke-width 1.5, fill='none', round caps/joins, aria-hidden='true', sized from --sl-size-icon-font-md. typographyFinding.claim: The implement-design-lit skill states a --sl-text-new-* token is a `font:` shorthand that resets font-weight. That is false for sanoma-pro.
typographyFinding.whatExists: Only longhands: --sl-text-new-{heading-sm,md,lg,xl,2xl}-{fontFamily,fontSize,lineHeight} and --sl-text-new-{body-sm,md,lg}-{fontFamily,fontSize,lineHeight,fontWeight}. Heading families ship NO -fontWeight longhand; the weight must come from --sl-text-new-typeset-fontWeight-semiBold / -regular. There is no bare --sl-text-new-heading-lg (etc.) anywhere in the theme.
typographyFinding.consequence: `font: var(--sl-text-new-heading-lg)` references an undefined custom property, so the entire declaration is dropped and the text silently falls back to the browser default - wrong family, size, and line-height at once.
typographyFinding.didAnyGateCatchIt: No. tsc does not read CSS. eslint and stylelint do not resolve custom properties. The harness render report only checks registration, shadow root and box size. Nothing flagged it - it was caught by the orchestrator grepping the theme, and it would otherwise have surfaced only as an unexplained Stage 4 fidelity miss.
typographyFinding.alreadyShippedWithTheSameBug: packages/components/progress-bar/src/progress-bar.css and packages/components/emoji/src/emoji-browser.css use the same non-resolving shorthand, which is why the implementer initially mirrored it as established convention.
